title: 第649章 娘亲喜欢谁第648章 爹爹一定会出现
lines: 戴缨抱着女儿，不知道发生了何事，见她那样委屈，突然提起想回家。
她知道她说的“家”是哪里，是簸箕巷，是那个城中城。
就在她思索之时，阿婠埋在娘亲怀里，抽噎道：“我不喜欢这里，也不喜欢这里的人。”
她抬头，双眼湿红，再道：“娘亲我们走，好不好。”
戴缨见她哭得伤心，耐心道：“阿婠，这里就是我们的家……”
不及她说完，阿婠抢说道：“这里不是家，是娘亲的家，不是阿婠的家，阿婠的家不在这里，阿婠想要爹爹……”
她一面说一面拿手背擦眼泪，可那眼泪怎么也擦不完：“阿婠想和以前一样，小小的院子，只有娘亲和爹爹，还有阿嬷，还有常婶婶。”
“爹爹做阿婠喜欢吃的饭，阿婠喜欢吃什么，他就做什么，爹爹是这个世上对阿婠最好的人，陪阿婠玩，带阿婠出街，阿婠要什么，爹爹就给什么，不对阿婠发脾气……”
戴缨拿袖子替她将泪水拭去，让她哭一会儿，缓一会儿，不去和她争辩，她若这个时候告诉她，那个不是你爹，这个才是你爹，不但不能抚平孩子的伤心，反而会加剧她的吵闹。
她也不想告诉孩子，阿伏干此人如何如何，小丫头心里有没有负担另说，即使她说了，她这么个年纪，并不懂什么，在她的小脑瓜里，对她好的就是好人，对她不好的就是坏人。
评判标准以自己为中心。
戴缨想了想，换了一种方式，问道：“阿婠，爹爹好不好？”
“哪个爹爹？”
“大爹爹。”戴缨说道，“阿婠你记住，娘亲口中的爹爹是指大爹爹。”
阿婠倒是没做犹豫，“嗯”了一声，点点头：“娘亲不喜欢二爹爹？”
戴缨微笑，并且十分肯定地说道：“娘亲心里喜欢的是大爹爹，不喜欢二爹爹。”
接着，她再问：“大爹爹可有对你发脾气？”
阿婠没说话，大爹爹的脸在脑中浮现，大爹爹和二爹爹不一样，完全不一样。
怎么不一样，她也说不上来，大爹爹说话温柔，笑得也温柔，是冬天的暖茶，刚沏下去，杯壁微凉，可握久了，热透出来，暖人。
二爹爹说话亮着嗓，笑起来，让人看着开心，也跟着笑，像什么呢，哎呀，一想到二爹爹脑子就是烤鸭和拨浪鼓。
“大爹爹不发脾气。”阿婠说道。
戴缨又问：“那你喜不喜欢大爹爹？”
阿婠没有立刻回答，而是低下头，过了一会，抬起头，再一次确认：“娘亲喜欢大爹爹？”
“是。”戴缨回答道。
“那阿婠也喜欢大爹爹。”说过后，她又补说一句，“但阿婠最喜欢的还是二爹爹……阿婠还是要二爹爹……娘亲，我们找二爹爹……”
小孩儿大多有一个共性，想要什么，那是一定要得到的，不给？哭，闹，再不就是耍赖，直到他们满意为止。
戴缨见她不改口，沉吟一番，问道：“想去找二爹爹？”
阿婠觉着娘亲这样发问，就是准备应下的意思，于是连连点头。
戴缨微笑道：“那好，我们去找二爹爹。”
“真的？！”阿婠语调扬起，小脸瞬间亮了起来。
戴缨“嗯”了一声，又道：“不过呢……你二爹爹住在很远的地方，咱们寻他得做一些准备，譬如路上的吃食，车马，还要雇佣护卫……”
她一项一项说出来，小到鞋袜，大到路上的食宿，想让女儿知难而退。
content_en:
Dai Ying hugged her daughter and didn't know what happened. Seeing how wronged she was, she suddenly mentioned that she wanted to go home.
She knew where the "home" she was talking about was, Dustpan Alley, the city within the city.
While she was thinking, A-Huan was buried in her mother's arms, sobbing and saying, "I don't like this place, and I don't like the people here either."
She raised her head, her eyes were wet and red, and said again: "Mom, let's go, okay."
Seeing her crying sadly, Dai Ying said patiently: "Ah Huan, this is our home..."
Before she could finish her words, A-Huan said: "This is not home, it is my mother's home, not A-Huan's home. A-Huan's home is not here. A-Huan wants daddy..."
As she spoke, she wiped her tears with the back of her hand, but she couldn't wipe away the tears: "Ah Huan wants to be like before, in a small courtyard with only mother and father, grandma, and Aunt Chang."
"Daddy cooks food that A'han likes to eat. He will cook whatever A'han likes to eat. Daddy is the best person in the world to A'han. He plays with A'han and takes A'han out on the street. Daddy will give A'wan whatever she wants and never lose his temper with A'han..."
Dai Ying wiped away her tears with her sleeve, letting her cry for a while, calm down for a while, and not argue with her. If she told her at this time that that is not your father, but this is your father, not only would it not be able to heal the child's sadness, but it would intensify her quarrel.
She didn't want to tell her child what Afugan was like. Whether the little girl had any burden in her heart was another matter. Even if she told her, she didn't understand anything at her age. In her little mind, people who were good to her were good people, and people who were bad to her were bad people.
The criteria for judging are self-centered.
Dai Ying thought for a while, then changed his approach and asked, "Ah Huan, are you okay, daddy?"
"Which daddy?"
"Big Daddy." Dai Ying said, "Ah Huan, remember, the daddy in my mother's mouth refers to Big Daddy."
Ah Hu didn't hesitate, she said "hmm" and nodded: "Mother, don't you like your second father?"
Dai Ying smiled and said with great certainty: "My mother likes the eldest daddy in her heart, but she doesn't like the second daddy."
Then, she asked again: "Has Big Daddy ever lost his temper with you?"
Ah Huan didn't say anything. The eldest daddy's face appeared in her mind. The eldest daddy and the second daddy were different, completely different.
She couldn't explain why it was different. Big Daddy spoke softly and smiled softly. It was warm tea in winter. When it was brewed, the walls of the cup were slightly cold, but after holding it for a long time, the heat came out and warmed people.
Second Daddy speaks with a bright voice and smiles, which makes people happy and laughs too. What does it look like? Oops, when I think of Second Daddy, my mind is filled with roast duck and rattles.
"Big Daddy doesn't lose his temper," Ah Huan said.
Dai Ying asked again: "Then do you like Big Daddy?"
Ah Huan did not answer immediately, but lowered her head. After a while, she raised her head and confirmed again: "Mom, do you like Big Daddy?"
"Yes." Dai Ying replied.
"Then Ah Hu also likes the eldest daddy." After saying that, she added, "But Ah Huan's favorite is the second daddy... Ah Huan still wants the second daddy... Mother, let's find the second daddy..."
Most children have one thing in common. Whatever they want, they must get it. If they don't give it to them, they must get it. Cry, make trouble, or just play tricks until they are satisfied.
Seeing that she didn't change her words, Dai Ying pondered for a while and asked, "Want to find the second father?"
A-Han felt that her mother was preparing to answer when she asked such a question, so she nodded repeatedly.
Dai Ying smiled and said, "Okay, let's go find the second father."
"Really?!" Ah Huan raised her voice and her little face lit up instantly.
Dai Ying said "Yes" and then said: "But... your second father lives far away. We have to make some preparations to find him, such as food on the road, carriages and horses, and hiring guards..."
She told them one by one, from shoes and socks to food and lodging on the road, hoping that her daughter would get out of the way.
title_en: Chapter 649: Who does mother like? Chapter 648: Father will definitely appear
